summary: A DFM Ratios cell with no ratio now shows the grey 1.0000 placeholder after loading a saved method, instead of a false 0.0000.
details: An origin period whose value is zero has no link ratio, but reopening the method drew that cell as a calculated 0.0000 that no column average reflected.
Reading a stored or calculated ratio now goes through one shared helper, so an empty cell can no longer be read as a ratio of zero.
